mapper.select: select ir.*, e.name as enterprise_name, cn.name as node_name, nd.diagnosis_tag from investment_recommendation ir left join enterprise e on ir.enterprise_id = e.id left join chain_node cn on ir.target_node_id = cn.id left join node_diagnosis nd on cn.id = nd.node_id and nd.is_deleted = 0 and nd.id = (select max(n2.id) from node_diagnosis n2 where n2.node_id = cn.id and n2.is_deleted = 0) where ir.id = #{id}

select ir.*, e.name as enterprise_name, e.description as industry, e.registered_address as region_code, cn.name as node_name, nd.diagnosis_tag from investment_recommendation ir left join enterprise e on ir.enterprise_id = e.id left join chain_node cn on ir.target_node_id = cn.id left join node_diagnosis nd on cn.id = nd.node_id and nd.is_deleted = 0 and nd.id = (select max(n2.id) from node_diagnosis n2 where n2.node_id = cn.id and n2.is_deleted = 0) where ir.enterprise_id = #{enterpriseId} and ir.target_node_id = #{nodeId} order by ir.total_score desc limit 1
